summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of up to $4,330,000 in ADSs issuable upon conversion of a convertible promissory note sold to Streeterville Capital LLC under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated August 26, 2026. The deal is a capital raise, not a special situation; price terms and conversion details are not fully specified, though the ADS last traded at $1.20 on August 25, 2026. A planned ADS ratio change effective September 8, 2026 will effect a one-for-seven reverse split. Investors should monitor conversion mechanics and potential dilution.
